Primary button: white on mint-45 is 2.80:1. It's the brand button, so a change here changes the brand. Options: accept it for large uppercase text (it passes neither AA nor AA-large), or darken the fill.
Avatar badge: white on mint-45 is 2.80:1, the same pair as the primary button; decide them together.
Tertiary button on hover: white text on a dark-45 fill is 2.30:1. Options: a darker hover fill (dark-75), or keep dark text on hover.
The checkmark only shows when checked, on the checked fill; the resting fill never has text on it.
The indicator only shows when checked, on the checked fill.
Solid mint badge: white on mint-45 is 2.80:1, the same pair as the primary button. Options: accept it with the button, or use mint-75 for the solid fill.
Solid success badge: white on mint-60 is 3.36:1. Options: accept it for short status labels, or use mint-75 for the solid fill.

Multiple-select checkbox: a white tick on mint-45 is 2.80:1, under the 3:1 a graphic needs. It's the same pair as the primary button and the Checkbox component. Options: accept it with those, or use mint-75 for the checked fill.

Success toast: the mint-60 title on the mint-l3 fill is 2.97:1. The icon passes the 3:1 a graphic needs, the title text doesn't. Options: accept it, or use the darker -75 shade for the title and icon.

Warning toast: the warning-60 title on the warning-l3 fill is 3.23:1. The icon passes the 3:1 a graphic needs, the title text doesn't. Options: accept it, or use the darker -75 shade for the title and icon.

Error toast: the error-60 title on the error-l1 fill is 3.28:1. The icon passes the 3:1 a graphic needs, the title text doesn't. Options: accept it, or use the darker -75 shade for the title and icon.
Current step: the white step number on mint-60 is 3.36:1. Options: accept it, or use mint-75 for the current step's fill.
A done step shows only a tick icon, which needs 3:1 as a graphic; mint-75 on mint-l2 is 4.33:1.
File card icon: the mint-60 file icon on the mint-l3 circle is 2.97:1, just under the 3:1 a graphic needs. It's the old BYBAttachment card's look. Options: accept it, or use mint-75 for the icon.
